title: TypeSafe AI Jev 1.14.0 is now available on Unity Gateway
body: TypeSafe AI [Jev 1.14.0](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#typesafe-ai-jev-1-14-0) is now available on Unity Gateway. TypeSafe AI hosts it, and an account admin must enable the **Externally-hosted TypeSafe AI Models** preview. TypeSafe's terms govern its use.
